purpose: Frozen independent-seed learning and nominal-gate performance verification; not a conditional disturbance-risk certificate
regimes: First 128 nominal, next 128 dense; fixed strata, not IID mixture risk-validation counts
methods: One strong team planner, all three raw final joint policies and all three unchanged nominal action gates
sharding: Global initial index modulo four; preserve global regime assignment and paired methods
primary_mean_performance_checks: Every raw training seed has positive mean team-cost improvement over the strong baseline
The fixed three-seed average raw improvement has a positive paired initial-cluster 95 percent lower endpoint
The fixed three-seed average raw policy improves the high-conflict group's mean cost
The three-seed average gate reduces mean team cost by at least 1 percent, with a positive paired initial-cluster 95 percent lower endpoint
The three-seed average gate has nonnegative mean cost and arrival improvement for each vehicle
Each complete nominal gated rollout respects the component-wise deterministic performance identity
Gate worst-mode individual-regression frequency is lower than raw learning, reported with both all-initial and admitted-initial denominators
All actual runs complete without recorded collision, contract violation or administrative abort
Each gated method has measured p95 controller computation below the 500 ms decision period; this is not a worst-case execution-time guarantee
interval_scope: Conditional on the three fixed trained models; average modes and models inside each initial before bootstrapping. Report every training seed separately; do not treat seed-by-mode outcomes as independent scenes
not_certified: Neither a per-state safety probability nor a bound on performance regression among admitted disturbed episodes is established by passing these mean-performance checks
retention: All methods, failures, outcomes, frozen sources and final weights retained. No checkpoint or seed selection after observing this set
